annotation_definition.body: Whole visible animal extent including head/ears/legs; bounding rectangle spans only observed pixels, not extrapolated hidden body. Uncertain partial body fragments retained explicitly.
annotation_definition.coordinate_order: native pixel xyxy, width640,height368; overlay upscaling is nearest-neighbor2x only.
annotation_definition.head: Visible head including ears; exclude neck, do not infer occluded anatomy. Plastic tag boxes retain publisher coordinates.
annotation_definition.links: Only visually followable physical tag-ear-head and head-neck-body connections. No nearest-body guess.

proposed_rule.metric: Not yet scored; independent annotation/source review then freeze first.
proposed_rule.uniqueness: Exactly one containing head per tag and exactly one containing body per head. Multiple tags may share head. No tie-breaking.

scope: Fixed three already-exposed low-resolution development frames. No model predictions/training, no biological identities, no digit reading. Bounding boxes describe only visible animal extent; uncertain partial attachments stay unknown. Same-animal links are an AI visual annotation draft, not certified field ground truth.
